name: Claude
source:
"If you're going to say boring things, I'm going to hold it against you."
 
Of the Aquilegian Imperial line, Claude is adorned with harsh words.
Serves as commander of the Imperial Army,
while never revealing true intentions to anyone.

[From [url=https://black00crown.com/en.html]English official site[/url]]
